intro: Charge-On Construction supports commercial build-outs, custom-home interiors and renovations throughout Central Florida. From framing and drywall to detailed finish carpentry, every scope begins with understanding the work and approaching the finished result with care.
location: Orlando, Winter Park, Sanford & Central Florida

services.title: Commercial interiors
services.description: Metal framing, drywall, acoustical ceilings and interior finishes for tenant improvements and renovations, with demolition, concrete and masonry scopes available to suit the project.

services.title: Custom-home interiors
services.description: Wood framing, drywall, doors, trim and finish carpentry — from baseboards and crown molding to wainscoting, beams and staircase details.

services.title: Renovations & remodeling
services.description: Selective demolition, framing changes, drywall, painting, flooring, doors and trim — considered around each property's existing conditions.

services.title: Repairs & finishing
services.description: Drywall patches, trim repairs, painting touch-ups and smaller construction projects handled with the same attention to detail.
